name: Industrial3D
description: Automated semantic understanding of dense point clouds is a prerequisite for Scan-to-BIM pipelines, digital twin construction, and as-built verification--core tasks in the digital transformation of the construction industry. Yet for industrial mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) facilities, this challenge remains largely unsolved: TLS acquisitions of water treatment plants, chiller halls, and pumping stations exhibit extreme geometric ambiguity, severe occlusion, and extreme class imbalance that architectural benchmarks (e.g., S3DIS or ScanNet) cannot adequately represent.
